# Vatican.va

> > Official digital infrastructure of the Holy See and Vatican City State, providing secure communication systems and administrative services for Vatican personnel and diplomatic operations.

Vatican.va serves as the technical backbone for the Holy See's digital operations, hosting email systems powered by Zimbra, passport information portals for diplomatic credentials, and human resources management platforms. These internal services support the administrative and diplomatic functions of the Vatican City State.

## Key Topics

- Holy See
- Vatican City State
- Zimbra webmail
- Diplomatic passports
- Service passports
- Vatican authentication
- Zucchetti HR
- Vatican telecommunications
- ePass system
- Vatican IT services
- Holy See documents
- Vatican employee portal
- Secure messaging

## Email and Communication Systems

- [Vaticano Webmail Sign In](https://autodiscover.vatican.va/): Vatican Zimbra webmail login for telecommunications and IT services
- [Zimbra Web Client Sign In](https://posta2.vatican.va/): Vatican Zimbra web client email login and messaging platform

## Diplomatic and Administrative Services

- [ePass Vatican Portal](https://epass.vatican.va/): Holy See passport information portal for diplomatic and service passports

## Human Resources and Employee Systems

- [Vatican HR Portal Login](https://attualita.vatican.va/): Vatican HR Portal employee authentication and access system
